verses.1: May the souls of Korach be destroyed upon the worlds of poetry.
verses.2: God has given us protection and strength to help us in our times of need.
verses.3: Therefore, I do not fear the land on which I stand, nor the mountains above me, in the midst of the seas.
verses.4: May they be destroyed from their very origins; may the mountains be destroyed by their power.
verses.5: May the rivers of Plegio rejoice, O holy city of God, from the dwellings of the people of Elion.
verses.6: God will help her in her hour of need. God will be there to assist her in the evening.
verses.7: The nations were destroyed by their kings. In their voices, they cried out for destruction over the land.
verses.8: May the Lord, your God, be with us, and may He save us from this situation. May the God of Jacob help us.
verses.9: Let us see the works of Jehovah, who has placed signs on the earth.
verses.10: The walls of war will be torn down to the ends of the earth. The ropes and ropes of chariots will be burned by fire.
verses.11: Rejoice and know that I am God, who reigns over all nations and over all lands.
verses.12: May Jehovah, your God, be with us and save us from our troubles. May the God of Jacob protect us.
